description:
FILED s438c (Opus 5) while closing #365, and it CORRECTS that task's guess.

#365 predicted the residue could not be fixed because there is "no environment
at repair time".  There IS one: `_repair_word_match` (Pl/Parser2.pm ~5133)
already asks `$self->_word_is_term($prev->content, $doc)`, which is exactly the
right question -- perl reads `/` after a bareword as DIVISION only when the
word is a TERM.  What it cannot see is an IMPORTED term:

  _word_is_term -> _word_is_declared_term -> _zero_arity_builtins
                                          -> _doc_term_words($doc)

and `_doc_term_words` is a scan of THIS DOCUMENT (its `use constant`s and its
own `sub NAME ()`).  A `()` sub that arrived through a `use` is in the
ENVIRONMENT's prototype table, not the document -- and the table is filled by
`_premerge_include_prototypes`, which Parser2::parse calls at ~line 1080,
AFTER the repair block at ~1006-1026.  So at repair time the answer is "not a
term" for every imported name, whatever the table would say later.

REPRO (needs #365's fix in, or `pi` is unknown for a second reason):

  use Math::Trig;
  my $q = pi / 2 + pi / 4;     # perl: 2.35619449019234
                               # PCL:  repaired to `pi m/ 2 + pi /` -> DROPPED
                               #       (announced; dies when reached since s435)
  my $x = pi / 2;              # ONE slash: no closing `/`, repair declines, correct

Identical on a fe46c7b worktree, so it is pre-existing and NOT a #365
regression -- #365 makes it visible by making the surrounding shapes right.

TWO CANDIDATE FIXES, and the order matters more than the predicate:
 (a) run `_premerge_include_prototypes($doc)` BEFORE the repair block, then let
     `_word_is_declared_term` also ask the environment
     (`Pl::Environment::proto_is_zero_arg` on `get_prototype($name)` -- the ONE
     predicate #365 introduced).  Cheapest in code, but it moves a seam: the
     pre-merge would walk an UNREPAIRED document, and a repair can call
     `_reparse_doc`, so the `use` statements it read are then stale elements.
     Extraction is memoized by MODULE NAME, so a re-merge after the repairs is
     idempotent -- measure whether running it twice is free.
 (b) leave the order alone and give `_word_is_term` a lazy path: for a name it
     cannot place, consult the document's `use` list on demand.  No seam moves;
     it duplicates a walk the pre-merge already does (rule 11 says find the
     shared point instead).
(a) with a second, post-repair pre-merge is the shape to measure first.

BAR: the four-population emission A/B (this changes when a table is filled, so
every file with a `use` is in scope), the gate, and a row in
Pl/t/imported-term-01.t (the guard file #365 added) asserting the two-slash
shape agrees with perl.  A census row leaves by EDIT if one is behind it.

DONE s443g (Opus, agent G round 4), commit a31aad4, ff-merged s444 -- shape (a) as ruled in #493.  _premerge_include_prototypes runs BEFORE the token repairs too (both runs needed: early walks the unrepaired doc, late sees the reparsed one; re-entrant, memoized, use-lib seeding deduped, local $! contains errno); _word_is_declared_term reads the Environment via the ONE record test Pl::Environment::proto_is_zero_arg.  pi/2+pi/4 fixed; 955-file A/B DIFF=0 (RCDIFF 3 = errno determinism, stdout identical); cost inside noise.  Gate-SET scan run by Fable over the merged batch.
subject: The #351 `WORD /` repair asks _word_is_term, which cannot see an IMPORTED term: `pi / 2 + pi / 4` becomes a MATCH and the statement drops -- the prototype pre-merge runs AFTER the repairs
